$comment: Arche UI token contract v1. Encodes the whole token surface from the Library Creation Spec §4.2. Token names are CSS-variable form. Colors are OKLCH. Every token requires a value in BOTH the light and the dark set of an identity. Amendment 2026-11 (Brand Token brief, same append-only pattern as --border-width): --brand and --brand-foreground join the contract; existing payloads predate them and gain them on regeneration (brandHue defaults to primaryHue). Amendment 2026-11 (Surfaces brief): --composition, --imagery, --surface-page and --surface-card join the contract as closed option tokens; existing payloads gain them on regeneration (derived from DNA + art direction). Amendment 2026-11 (Surface photo brief): photo treatments render the --surface-photo image (default example_bg_photo.jpg, replaceable in the Studio sidebar); --surface-card loses the photo options (no container for it) and illustration/shapes are removed from both surface lists. Amendment 2026-11 (Surface trim): --surface-section and --surface-band leave the contract; sections and bands stay unpainted so the page treatment beneath shows through. Amendment 2026-11 (Scrim color brief): --surface-scrim joins the contract as the photo readability veil's color (white in light, black in dark); existing payloads gain it on regeneration. Amendment 2026-11 (Block backgrounds brief): --surface-page leaves the contract; blocks carry their own background choice (per-block, defaulting to the identity background), and generation picks one shared choice for all hero blocks.

tokens.name: --radius
tokens.$note: sm/md/lg/xl are derived by calc() at emission; only the base is a token.

tokens.name: --border-width
tokens.$note: Mode-independent: same value light/dark. Component templates use border-(length:--border-width); never hardcode a border width. Per-profile bounds for generated payloads live in design rule border-width-profile-bounds.

tokens.name: --composition
tokens.$note: Mode-independent: same value light/dark. Page composition affinity. Derived from DNA + art direction; editable in the Studio sidebar.

tokens.name: --imagery
tokens.$note: Mode-independent: same value light/dark. Imagery direction for the page. Derived from DNA + art direction; editable in the Studio sidebar.

tokens.name: --surface-card
tokens.$note: Mode-independent: same value light/dark. Card surface treatment. No photo options (cards have no image container). Editable in the Studio sidebar.

tokens.name: --surface-photo
tokens.$note: Mode-independent: same value light/dark. Image rendered by the photo surface options, as a url(...) string. Default example_bg_photo.jpg; replaceable in the Studio sidebar.

tokens.name: --surface-tint
tokens.$note: Mode-independent: same value light/dark. Lead hue for the procedural surface treatments, as any CSS color. Default 'initial' (recipes fall back to their authored roles); the Studio sidebar sets it with a color picker.

tokens.name: --surface-photo-scrim
tokens.$note: Mode-independent: same value light/dark. Readability veil over the photo treatments: lightens in light mode for dark text, darkens in dark mode for light text. On by default; the Studio sidebar toggles it next to the photo reset.

tokens.name: --surface-scrim
tokens.$note: Veil color for the photo readability scrim: white in light, black in dark. The Studio sidebar edits it with a color picker next to the scrim toggle.
